PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  June 13, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, May 13, 2019,
at 2:06 pm in the Community Room “A”, 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk
  Debra Crenshaw, Deputy City Treasure
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer – 2:18 pm
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Officer Sean Yanez, Police Department
  Marissa Fewell, Planning & Building Department

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
May 23, 2019.

Business License Request(s):

Item #1:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the Business License
  request for Tamari Zeigler DBA FAB Hair International to operate a hair
  salon at 1100 W. Florence Avenue #A3, subject to payment of annual
  business license and tax fees; Business owner must possess and maintain
  valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of Barbering
  & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists
  operating within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from
  the State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers,
  Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the establishment is required
  to register and file business tax with the City; Business owner shall provide
  valid and current government-issued identification and copies of applicable
  state licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the
  establishment to the Finance Department; Parties, social events or
  gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; shall apply/submit application
  for permit for other social/party events. Consumption of alcoholic
  beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis activity) is not permitted
  on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the body is not permitted;
  Adhere to all applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
 Permits & License Committee  June 13, 2019
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

  including noise and signage, local, state and federal laws. APPLICANT
  AND EMPLOYEES ARE EXPECTED TO BE ACTIVE PARTICIPANTS IN
  CALLING POLICE FOR POLICE RELATED, UNUSUAL, ILLEGAL,
  AND/OR ACTIVTY THAT MAY NECESSITATE A POLICE RESPONSE
  OR RESPONSE FROM OTHER CITY GOVERNMENT SERVICES (I.E.
  CODE ENFORCEMENT, PLANNING, FINANCE, ETC.) Failure to comply
  with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business
  license and any future business license application requests. (Activity No.
  00275327)

Item #2:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the Business License
  request for Yolande Franklin of Maximum Affair DBA –GLOWWW to
  operate a hair salon at 1100 N. La Brea Avenue, Suite 104. subject to
  payment of annual business license and tax fees; Business owner must
  possess and maintain valid and current Establishment License from the
  State Board of Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers,
  Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the establishment must
  possess applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering &
  Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists
  operating within the establishment is required to register and file business
  tax with the City; Business owner shall provide valid and current
  government-issued identification and copies of applicable state licensing
  on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the establishment to
  the Finance Department; Parties, social events or gatherings of any type is
  strictly prohibited; shall apply/submit application for permit for other
  social/party events. Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use
  (including cannabis activity) is not permitted on the premises; Massage
  therapy of any part of the body is not permitted; Adhere to all applicable
  Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage, local, state and federal laws. APPLICANT AND EMPLOYEES
  ARE EXPECTED TO BE ACTIVE PARTICIPANTS IN CALLING POLICE
  FOR POLICE RELATED, UNUSUAL, ILLEGAL, AND/OR ACTIVTY THAT
  MAY NECESSITATE A POLICE RESPONSE OR RESPONSE FROM
  OTHER CITY GOVERNMENT SERVICES (I.E. CODE ENFORCEMENT,
  PLANNING, FINANCE, ETC.) Failure to comply with any of the
  aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and
  any future business license application requests. (Activity No. 00274885)

Item #3:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the Business License
  request for Ramiro Sanchez-Avila DBA AMI Motors to operate a Used Car
  Dealer at 359 N. Oak Street. Applicant requires 1 parking space for office,
  and has additional 2 spaces; only 2 vehicles permitted to be parked on-
  site. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations; no parking or storing
  vehicles or inventory on any public right of way; subject to inspection by
  any  Code  Enforcement  Officer  or  Police  Officer;  all
  applicant/employees/agent must be in possession of government
  identification during business operation and shall present it at the request
  of any city official. Adhere to all applicable IMC regulations and all State
  and Federal Laws. (Activity No. 00275429)
 Permits & License Committee  June 13, 2019
Minutes  Page 3 of 4

Tobacco Retailer License Request(s):

Item #4:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the Tobacco Retailer
  License request for Kevin Bibayan DBA Century Oil Partners Inc. to
  operate as tobacco retailer at 9830 Crenshaw Blvd. subject to sales of
  single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and
  e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited; persons
  purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have valid
  identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; “NO
  LOITERING,” “NO TRESSPASSING,” and “NO PANHANDLING” signage
  must be posted outside of the business; sales of marijuana and cannabis
  products, narcotics and narcotics paraphernalia, i.e., any type of pipe used
  to ingest other narcotics such as base “crack” cocaine, methamphetamine,
  including glass cylindrical tube and bubble shaped pipes used to smoke
  and/or ingest narcotics; sales of Tobacco pipes is permitted; sales or
  display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray,
  Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited; Tobacco Retailer business owners
  and/or new applicants or their designees is subject to random Permits &
  Licensing establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any
  Police and Code Enforcement officers; purpose of random inspections is
  to enforce business establishments adhere to the regulations set forth by
  the City of Inglewood and for Community Public Health & Safety; parties,
  social events or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes,
  live bands/music, disc jockeys (DJ’s), etc., is strictly prohibited; business
  owner(s) is required to operate within normal business hours; adhere to all
  applicable IMC rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion
  carried and approved with City Treasurer denying. (Activity No. 00275297)

Item #5:  A motion was moved and seconded to APPROVE the Tobacco Retailer
  License request for Andrew Faour and Tony Hawara DBA Forum Liquor to
  operate as tobacco retailer at 801 S. Prairie Avenue subject to sales of
  single cigarettes is strictly prohibited; sales of tobacco, hookah, vapor and
  e-cigarette products to minors, under age 21 is strictly prohibited; persons
  purchasing tobacco or any related tobacco products shall have valid
  identification on their person at all times to enforce laws restricting
  underage access to tobacco use, including hookah products; “NO
  LOITERING,” “NO TRESSPASSING,” and “NO PANHANDLING” signage
  must be posted outside of the business; sales of marijuana and cannabis
  products, narcotics and narcotics paraphernalia, i.e., any type of pipe used
  to ingest other narcotics such as base “crack” cocaine, methamphetamine,
  including glass cylindrical tube and bubble shaped pipes used to smoke
  and/or ingest narcotics; sales of Tobacco pipes is permitted; sales or
  display of any type of weapons, i.e., clubs, swords, knives, pepper spray,
  Taser/Stun guns is strictly prohibited; Tobacco Retailer business owners
  and/or new applicants or their designees is subject to random Permits &
  Licensing establishment inspections at any time of the day or night by any
  Police and Code Enforcement officers; purpose of random inspections is
  to enforce business establishments adhere to the regulations set forth by
  the City of Inglewood and for Community Public Health & Safety; parties,
  social events or gatherings of any type is strictly prohibited; music boxes,
